speaker_enrollment.notes: Speaker profiles saved as JSON (profile.to_dict()) to disk via _save_profile(). Embeddings stored as plain lists in JSON — no encryption at rest.
No raw audio recording or retention code found; only embeddings (38-dim spectral descriptors) are stored.

voice_authorization_boundary.notes: No code found linking speaker identity to action authorization. Speaker ID is published to awareness engine (VOICE_SPEAKER_CHANGED) but not used to gate actions.

memory_deletion_cascade.file_line: core/persistent_memory.py delete_entry() removes from _entries and vector store
memory_deletion_cascade.notes: EnhancedMemoryEngine.delete_entry() removes entry from _entries and calls _vector_store.delete(). export_for_backup/import_from_backup also handle embeddings.

dashboard_network.file_line: dashboard/server.py _bind_host() line 63-64 requires KD_ALLOW_LAN=1 for non-loopback
dashboard_network.notes: Dashboard binds loopback by default; LAN requires explicit env flag; all three WebSocket endpoints check origin.

cloud_consent.notes: providers/llm_router.py routes to Ollama (local) by default. No per-data-category cloud consent enforcement found. OpenRouter not integrated.

notes: No OS keyring or protected service credentials integration found. API keys stored in config/api_keys.json as plain JSON.
core/diagnostics.py explicitly avoids echoing exception strings/response bodies. providers/llm_router.py marks api_key as kind='secret'.
core/action_loader.py dispatches actions via TOOL dicts. No required-permissions field, no enforcement, no pre-execution confirmation.
recommended_next_steps: Encrypt speaker embeddings at rest (e.g., Fernet/OS keyring).
Add voice authorization boundary: voice match personalizes but cannot authorize sensitive actions.
Add per-data-category cloud consent enforcement; migrate API keys to OS keyring.
Add action permission enforcement with required-permissions metadata and pre-execution confirmation.
Add full audit log for authorization decisions and observed results.
verdict: Speaker enrollment, memory deletion cascade, dashboard network boundaries, and key-not-logged are implemented. Missing: encrypted embeddings at rest, voice authorization boundary, cloud consent by data category, keyring integration, action permission enforcement.
